p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # The color key is a row repeated several times. Read its nonzero colors
    # from left to right.
    key = None
    for r in range(h):
        vals = tuple(grid[r])
        if not any(vals):
            continue
        run = 1
        while r + run < h and tuple(grid[r + run]) == vals:
            run += 1
        colors = [v for v in vals if v != 0]
        if run >= 2 and len(colors) >= 2 and (key is None or len(colors) > len(key[0])):
            cols = [c for c, v in enumerate(vals) if v != 0]
            key = (colors, r, run, cols)
    if key is None:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    colors, key_top, key_h, key_cols = key
    key_cells = {(r, c) for r in range(key_top, key_top + key_h) for c in key_cols}

    # The shape is the non-key pattern in color 1. Preserve all its cells,
    # including diagonally separated parts of the same drawn silhouette.
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
             if grid[r][c] == 1 and (r, c) not in key_cells]
    if not cells:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    shape = [[1 if (r, c) in set(cells) else 0
              for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)]
             for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]

    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    sh, sw = len(shape), len(shape[0])
    top = h - len(colors) * sh
    for i, color in enumerate(colors):
        for dr in range(sh):
            for dc in range(sw):
                if shape[dr][dc]:
                    out[top + i * sh + dr][c0 + dc] = color
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
print(p, p.exists(), len(code))
